I will finish this wheat crop first, because it is already in the field from the winter season, and I will manage it with steady fertilizer, a few irrigations, and basic pest and disease control so I do not risk losing yield. After harvest, I will go straight into summer maize on the same land. I will use hybrid maize because I want stronger yield and better stand uniformity. I will keep management simple and practical: enough fertilizer to push grain yield, not too many sprays, and reduced tillage after wheat so I can save labor and turn the crop quickly. I am 59, so I will choose the system I trust most, one that gives me stable grain, uses the whole year, and does not depend on complicated management.
